text: Harness: per-cycle trace store for replay and evaluation
description: Persist per cycle: harness config version, compiled context per stage, model outputs, tool calls, diff, verdict, usage. Stored under .bowman/runtime/traces (gitignored, size-bounded). Enables replaying a stage with another model or config, offline A/B comparison, and the memory-usefulness measurement (did a reflection in context change the decision?).

status.comment: packages/loop-worker/src/traces.ts: every cycle writes .bowman/runtime/traces/<start>-<idea8>.json (gitignored; newest 200 kept) with loop config incl. role models and system prompt, per stage: role model, system, compiled prompt, tool calls with inputs/outputs/errors, text, submitted result, usage, duration; plus the git status+diff the verifier saw, the status the harness wrote, cycle notes and summed usage. The cycle's status event names the trace file. Evidence: cycle.test.ts asserts stages, tool calls, compiled prompt, verifiedDiff, statusChange and usage in the written trace; traces.test.ts naming + pruning; loop-worker 21/21; backend loop-cycle e2e 3/3. Replay tooling itself is not built yet; the data is there.
